marketed_by: Meril Life Sciences India Pvt. Ltd.
tagline: The Power to Eliminate. The Promise to Protect.
description: Isopropyl Alcohol IP – 70% Solution for effective surface disinfection and equipment cleaning.

for_surface: Wipe the surface to physically remove any contaminants
Spray from a distance of 6–8 inches on surface
Apply directly onto surfaces ensuring even coverage
Keep surfaces visibly wet for effective disinfection
Always close the nozzle after use
for_electronic_equipment: Spray MIREY 70% IPA onto a sterile gauze to moisten it
Do not spray directly on screens or sensitive electronic equipment
Wipe the screen or surface gently in one direction only to avoid streaks and static damage

precaution: Avoid use on alcohol-sensitive materials such as acrylic glass

key_properties: Safe for electronic equipment when applied via gauze
Effective surface disinfection and equipment cleaning

ideal_for: Medical equipment and electronic device cleaning
Operating theatres, ICUs and clinical areas
key_strengths: Rapid evaporation with no harsh chemicals
